icon:
Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: production app icon for "TV Show Manager", a desktop/mobile media library organizer.
Create ONE original icon, square 1024x1024, true transparent background. A sculptural matte folded ribbon forms a softly rounded widescreen television outline, with a crisp triangular play-shaped negative-space opening in its center and a subtle second offset film-card layer suggesting organized seasons. Bold simple silhouette, no tiny film perforations, no text, no letters, no outer app tile, no presentation mockup.
Design direction drawn from the user's Copilot logo reference: broad continuous folded bands, beautifully rounded corners, carefully controlled overlapping surfaces, modern material design. Create a distinct TV/play symbol rather than the Copilot infinity/S logo.
Palette harmonizes with a dark navy interface: mint/seafoam and jade dominant, a restrained periwinkle fold and small warm apricot edge. Satin matte ceramic-like finish, very subtle soft volumetric shading, no shiny plastic, no chrome, no busy rainbow, no external glow, no cast shadow outside the mark. Straight-on orthographic composition, centered, mark fills 82% of canvas with clean transparent margins; clear at 24 pixels. The entire background including inside the play aperture must be actual alpha transparency. No checkerboard painted into the image.
splash:

Reference image 1 is the approved original app icon: preserve its matte folded television/play mark, mint jade periwinkle and apricot palette. Reference image 2 is a COMPOSITION AND MOOD reference only: Photoshop 2017 split splash with a dark information panel on the left and a luminous cavern portal on the right. Create entirely original artwork, no Adobe or Photoshop logos/text.
Create a polished floating splash composition with actual alpha transparency OUTSIDE its shape, broad transparent outer margin on ALL FOUR sides, no checkerboard. Left 38 percent is a deep midnight navy softly rounded semi-opaque matte panel. At its upper left place a small faithful copy of the reference TV/play icon; underneath clean modern left-aligned off-white typography, exact title on two lines "TV Show" / "Manager". Small mint line "YOUR LIBRARY. IN PERFECT ORDER." Near the bottom a thin mint progress rule and exact small text "Preparing your workspace". No other copy.
Right 62 percent is original cinematic layered-paper / matte sculptural concept art: sweeping folded teal and navy ribbon canyons curve into a luminous seafoam portal shaped like a rounded PLAY TRIANGLE, evoking opening a new episode. Tiny floating rectangular film-frame tiles follow the curve, extremely restrained apricot and periwinkle accent planes. No person, no photorealistic landscapes. Deep exquisite tactile matte layers and quiet atmospheric light, no neon glow, no busy scenery. The artwork extends slightly beyond the rectangular panel as elegantly cutout ribbons; transparency between a few separated outer layers and around the overall silhouette. Keep all important elements inside canvas with generous clear edges. Sophisticated editorial creative-software splash, calm premium composition. Real transparency is essential; no solid full-canvas background.
